name: Customer complaint triage
description: Classifies a Vietnamese customer complaint by product area and urgency and routes it to a person or the queue. Fraud and complaints that mention legal action always go to a person.
use_cases: complaint intake from app, e-mail and call-centre notes
safeguards: card, ID, phone, e-mail and account numbers are redacted before the model call
fraud routing and urgency are enforced in code, not only in the prompt
traces carry token counts, cost and prompt version, never the complaint text
human_oversight: Fraud and legal-threat complaints are always handled by a person; other complaints enter the normal queue where agents can re-categorise them.
limitations: labels written by one person; urgency definition not yet agreed with the business

name: Loan dossier extraction and gating
description: Classifies the documents of a consumer loan dossier (application form, citizen ID card, payslip), reads their fields, and routes the dossier to underwriting, review or back to the customer with rule-based checks.
use_cases: document completeness and consistency checks before underwriting
safeguards: routing is decided by deterministic rules, not by the model
every extracted value must occur in the text of text-layer documents
cross-document checks on name, ID number and date of birth; CCCD number and expiry rules on scanned cards
ID numbers masked in API listings; the model-call journal stores no document content
human_oversight: Any failed check sends the dossier to a reviewer, who accepts or returns it with a note. The workflow never approves or declines credit.
limitations: evaluated on synthetic documents in three layouts only
reads the front of the ID card only
poor scans send clean dossiers to review (60% of clean stress dossiers with Sonnet)

name: Loan product policy question answering
description: Answers staff questions about a loan product from the policy documents only, citing the sections used, and declines questions the policy does not cover. Hybrid retrieval (local multilingual embeddings plus BM25).
use_cases: branch and call-centre staff questions about product rules, fees and process

evaluation.dataset: eval/rag_questions.jsonl (30 in scope, 6 out of scope)

safeguards: answers are limited to retrieved sections and must cite them; an uncited answer is treated as unanswerable
citations are restricted to the IDs of the retrieved sections
embeddings are computed locally, so policy text is not sent out at indexing time
human_oversight: Answers are for staff, not customers. Each answer shows its sources so staff can check the policy text.
limitations: 32 policy sections; not tested on a large or conflicting corpus
lexical weight tuned on the evaluation questions themselves

name: Vietnamese identifier redaction
description: Replaces card numbers (Luhn-checked), citizen and old ID numbers, Vietnamese phone numbers, e-mail addresses and labelled account numbers with typed placeholders before text reaches a model or a log.
use_cases: pre-processing for any prompt that carries customer text
safeguards: unit tests for each identifier type and for amounts and transaction codes that must not be masked
limitations: pattern-based; does not detect names or addresses
account numbers are found only after a label such as "STK"
no measured precision and recall on real text yet, which is what validated requires
